value.rationale: An all-parameter proven integral split lower bound advances explicitly open Conjecture 4.3 for total three-cut complexes of clique-by-path strips. The rank is quadratic in row count and gap count, and establishes non-shellability for an infinite natural family. A construction with explicit dual cycles/cochains supplies a reusable geometric method, not a routine small-instance calculation.
